C1342.title: NIST Releases First Three Post-Quantum Cryptography Standards
C1342.summary: In August 2024, the U.S. National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) officially published its first three post-quantum cryptography standards (FIPS 203, 204, 205), marking the transition of post-quantum cryptography into the standardization phase.
